steps.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game environment art for Heroes of Orvesk, dark gothic fantasy painted realism. Natural large masses and convincing volume, restrained textured brushwork, aged materials, muted earth/olive/charcoal/stone palette, upper-left daylight, readable middle-dark values, atmospheric depth without washed-out whitening. Never photorealistic drone photography, flat vector art, cute cartoon, plastic 3D, neon, modern objects, sci-fi, heroic saturated colors. No characters, creatures, text, labels, UI, markers, circles, graph nodes, frames, watermarks or vignette. Full-bleed opaque image; fill every edge with environment, no black fades. Asset type: separate ground-level combat-screen landscape backdrop of the same region, not an overhead map. Create ONE landscape image, requested exact 1672 x 941 pixels, approximately 16:9. Wide eye-level environmental view. Calm lower-center ground and subdued mid/upper-center backdrop for a separate game interface, but NOT a deliberately flat rectangular empty area. Place most intricate texture at the sides and middle distance; retain recognizable material and architectural features through a narrow center crop too. No painted battlefield grid, empty round combat arena or laid-out path. Scene: Ground-level view at an abandoned farmyard near the old stone bridge. Charred cottage walls and dead orchard branches frame a broad uneven muddy foreground; part of the low stone bridge and gatehouse is visible through smoke in the middle distance. Ash-grey sky and a restrained warm left light; not a volcanic landscape. Regional continuity: Ravaged rural frontier before the walled town of Perevalets: burned timber farmhouses on low rough stone foundations, blackened roof beams and dead orchard trees, ash mixed with muddy grey-brown soil, ruined low field walls, patches of muted dry olive grass. A broad grey river enters one side; one worn low medieval stone bridge and its gatehouse survive near it, compact features without a road connected to them. Scattered farm ruins lie throughout the environment, not a single centered landmark. Recent war and abandoned homes, drifting thin smoke, no active fire.
notes: Exact copies of generated originals. Map outputs were 1402x1122 rather than requested 3000x2400; actual dimensions recorded in the catalog. No stretching, cropping or repainting. Mobile delivery copies are produced by the existing sync_content.py pipeline.
Accepted: location matches chapter, no UI or itinerary, opaque, map and battle view share palette and materials.
